annotations.text:
The same Face (operador_medgrupo: GO, cues, transport, universes) in three Themes.
The Face pins what exists and where; the Theme pins window shape, chrome, LCD, typography.
Principle 5 of design/PRINCIPIOS.md: one Theme dresses any Face.

Color = state. Gray idle; amber selection/active; lime green only GO/ok; red live/error; wisteria rehearsal.
No decorative color. Tokens in design/tokens/spellcaster.css.

Face editor: splittable areas (Blender), graph in the center (TouchDesigner: node family = fixed color).
The command palette at the top shows the real registry name.
Agent panel: the AI's proposal becomes a diff with Apply / Rehearse / Discard.
